objectives.description: Master relational queries, advanced filtering, and aggregations to extract business answers.
masteryCriteria: Write SELECT queries with WHERE filtering and ORDER BY sorting.
Perform aggregations and groupings using GROUP BY and HAVING.
Join tables using INNER and LEFT JOIN without duplicate rows.

objectives.description: Build pivot tables and tabular models to analyze quantitative information.
masteryCriteria: Apply logical and conditional lookup functions.
Build pivot tables organizing dimensions and metrics.
Create visualizations that communicate key trends.

objectives.description: Write Python scripts to process tabular data using native structures.
masteryCriteria: Import and debug standard data processing modules.

activities.title: SQL Fundamentals and SELECT Syntax
activities.mission: Explore how basic queries interrogate relational databases and extract initial insights.
activities.instructions: Review introductory chapters and note three use cases where a WHERE filter is essential.
activities.successCriteria: Correctly identify the source table, projected columns, and filtering criteria.

activities.title: Guided Practice: Queries with Filters
activities.mission: Test your skills by formulating queries over a sales transaction dataset.
activities.instructions:
1. Open the practice database.
2. Write a query to filter orders from the last quarter.
3. Sort results by total volume descending.
activities.successCriteria: Query executes without syntax errors and returns only the expected rows.

activities.title: Fast Analysis with Pivot Tables
activities.mission: Learn how to summarize thousands of rows into a compact executive view using pivot tables.
activities.instructions: Watch the tutorial paying close attention to placing fields across rows, columns, and values.
activities.successCriteria: Understand the difference between sum and count summaries in a financial report.

activities.title: Practice: Creating Pivot Tables
activities.mission: Transform a flat tabular file into a pivot table with subtotals by department.
activities.instructions:
1. Import the spreadsheet.
2. Insert a pivot table.
3. Place department in rows and budget in values.
activities.successCriteria: Pivot table displays the budget sum correctly grouped by department.

activities.title: Deep Dive: Joins and Groupings
activities.mission: Combine customer and order tables to determine which segment generates the highest profit margin.
activities.instructions:
1. Write an INNER JOIN between customers and orders.
2. Group by customer segment.
3. Calculate average purchase value.
activities.successCriteria: Resulting report displays accurate metrics for each customer segment.

activities.title: Capstone Project: Commercial Audit
activities.mission: Develop a comprehensive order analysis for the operations team using advanced queries.
activities.instructions:
1. Design a complex query consolidating metrics by region.
2. Identify the three branches with lowest turnover.
3. Write two actionable conclusions based on the data.
activities.successCriteria: Complete SQL script produces the final table and the written summary answers the business question.

weeklySummaries.headline: Week 1: Mastering the Language of Data
weeklySummaries.note: We begin by exploring SQL fundamentals, building confidence to write clear and effective queries.

weeklySummaries.headline: Week 2: Patterns and Synthesis in Spreadsheets
weeklySummaries.note: This week you will learn to quickly summarize large volumes of data to identify key trends.

weeklySummaries.headline: Week 3: Relationships and Advanced Aggregations
weeklySummaries.note: You will connect multiple data dimensions to answer higher-impact business questions.

weeklySummaries.headline: Week 4: Consolidation Project
weeklySummaries.note: You will integrate everything learned into a practical case demonstrating real analytical capability.

changeExplanation: Ajustamos tu ruta de aprendizaje a partir de la última evaluación para priorizar refuerzos en conceptos clave y optimizar la distribución de tiempo semanal.
